newsitem.title: UK: Monument, Mobil in Turkmenistan PSA.
newsitem.headline: Monument, Mobil in Turkmenistan PSA.

text.p: Britain's Monument Oil and Gas Plc said on Monday that Mobil Exploration and Producing Turkmenistan Inc. joined a production sharing agreement (PSA) between Monument and the government of Turkmenistan to develop and explore the Nebit Dag licence in Western Turkmenistan.

Under a second agreement, Monument and Mobil Exploration and Producing Turkmenistan, a unit of U.S. oil group Mobil Oil Corp., also extended their exploration and producing programme to cover other opportunities in the same region, Monument said.

The Nebit Dag Area is operated by Monument and covers a 2,000 square kilometre area near the Caspian Sea containing five producing properties and additional exploration opportunities. Mobil now holds a 40 per cent working interest in the Nebit Dag Area, Monument said.

Monument, as operator, has started seismic covering the entire licence. Field operations, including extensive reviews of the Burun field facilities and pipeline systems, have begun and additional production is expected to begin by the second quarter of 1997.

Monument said it and Mobil also agreed with the government on rights to negotiate a production sharing agreement for a region near the Caspian coast. The 18,000 square kilometre area covers most of the country's onshore oil producing region, Monument said.
